			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_rail_lorries_applied
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_harvest_accounts_applied }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.15 }

		}

	}

COLDWAR_CUB_sync_programmes = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CUB_is_1970 = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_initialized }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_agricolture_productivity_modifier = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_agriculture_district_income_tax_modifier = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_civilian_factories_productivity = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_foreign_influence_defense_modifier = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_imp_sanction_resistance = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_production_factory_efficiency_gain_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_production_speed_buildings_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_tax_gain_multiplier_modifier = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_total_workforce_modifier = 0 }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_economy_active
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_finish_zafra_applied
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_harvest_resolved }
			}
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_agricolture_productivity_modifier = 0.12 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_total_workforce_modifier = 0.02 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_production_speed_buildings_factor = -0.04 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_economy_active
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_restore_sectors_applied }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_production_speed_buildings_factor = 0.1 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_civilian_factories_productivity = 0.08 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_agricolture_productivity_modifier = -0.04 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_economy_active
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_sugar_exports_applied }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_agricolture_productivity_modifier = 0.15 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_agriculture_district_income_tax_modifier = 0.08 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_imp_sanction_resistance = -0.05 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_economy_active
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_food_first_applied }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_agricolture_productivity_modifier = 0.1 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_imp_sanction_resistance = 0.12 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_agriculture_district_income_tax_modifier = -0.1 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_economy_active
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_protected_enterprises_applied }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_civilian_factories_productivity = 0.12 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_imp_sanction_resistance = 0.1 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_production_speed_buildings_factor = -0.05 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_economy_active
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_joint_ventures_applied }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_production_speed_buildings_factor = 0.12 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_civilian_factories_productivity = 0.06 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_production_factory_efficiency_gain_factor = 0.08 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_tax_gain_multiplier_modifier = -0.04 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_foreign_influence_defense_modifier = -0.1 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_economy_active
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_anap_cooperatives_applied }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_total_workforce_modifier = 0.02 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_agriculture_district_income_tax_modifier = -0.06 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_economy_active
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_light_industry_applied }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_civilian_factories_productivity = 0.06 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_economy_active
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_harvest_accounts_applied }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_civilian_factories_productivity = 0.04 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_economy_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.03 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_economy_active
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_economy_active }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CUB_economy_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CUB_economy_programme }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CUB_economy_programme }
				}
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CUB_economy_programme }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_education_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_foreign_influence_modifier = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_health_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_healthcare_income_multiplier_modifier = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_healthcare_workforce_requirement_modifier = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_monthly_population = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_research_speed_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_total_workforce_modifier = 0 }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_society_active
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_rural_clinics_applied }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_healthcare_workforce_requirement_modifier = -0.08 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_monthly_population = 0.03 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_health_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.08 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_society_active
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_teaching_hospitals_applied }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_research_speed_factor = 0.06 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_healthcare_income_multiplier_modifier = 0.08 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_health_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.12 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_society_active
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_medical_brigades_applied }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_foreign_influence_modifier = 0.12 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_health_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.1 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_society_active
		}
		if = {

			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_healthcare_income_multiplier_modifier = 0.12 }

			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_foreign_influence_modifier = -0.04 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_society_active
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_social_promise_applied }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_research_speed_factor = 0.03 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_education_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.05 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_society_active
		}
		if = {

			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_total_workforce_modifier = 0.03 }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_society_education_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.06 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_society_active
		}

			if = {

					NOT = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CUB_society_programme }
					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CUB_society_programme }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CUB_society_programme }
				}
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CUB_society_programme }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_defence_army_attack_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_defence_army_core_defence_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_defence_army_defence_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_defence_army_fuel_consumption_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_defence_army_org_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_defence_army_personnel_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_defence_political_power_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_defence_send_volunteer_size = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_defence_special_forces_cap = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CUB_defence_supply_consumption_factor = 0 }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_defence_active

			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_territorial_defence_applied }

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_defence_active
		}
		if = {
			limit = {

				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_foreign_advisers_applied }

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_defence_active
		}

				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_mission_schools_applied
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_foreign_advisers_applied }

COLDWAR_CUB_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_CUB_is_1970 = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_initialized }
		}
		log = "COLDWAR_CUB initialization: establish missing budget categories"
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					OR = { has_idea = edu_01 has_idea = edu_02 has_idea = edu_03 has_idea = edu_04 has_idea = edu_05 }
				}
			}
			add_ideas = edu_02
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						has_idea = health_01
						has_idea = health_02
						has_idea = health_03
						has_idea = health_04
						has_idea = health_05
						has_idea = health_06
					}
				}
			}
			add_ideas = health_02
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						has_idea = corruption_level_01
						has_idea = corruption_level_02
						has_idea = corruption_level_03
						has_idea = corruption_level_04
						has_idea = corruption_level_05
						has_idea = corruption_level_06
						has_idea = corruption_level_07
						has_idea = corruption_level_08
						has_idea = corruption_level_09
						has_idea = corruption_level_10
					}
				}
			}
			add_ideas = corruption_level_04
		}
		log = "COLDWAR_CUB initialization: national circumstances"
		add_ideas = {
			COLDWAR_CUB_zafra_campaign
			COLDWAR_CUB_revolutionary_offensive
			COLDWAR_CUB_sugar_oil
			COLDWAR_CUB_american_embargo
			COLDWAR_CUB_committees_defence
			COLDWAR_CUB_social_achievements
			COLDWAR_CUB_exile_divide
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_initialized
		log = "COLDWAR_CUB initialization: reconcile programmes"
		COLDWAR_CUB_sync_programmes = yes
		log = "COLDWAR_CUB initialization complete"
	}
}

			COLDWAR_CUB_apply_foreign_ddr_industry = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_CUB_foreign_ddr_science
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_foreign_ddr_science_applied }
			}
			COLDWAR_CUB_apply_foreign_ddr_science = yes
		}
		COLDWAR_CUB_history_update = yes
		COLDWAR_CUB_diplomacy_daily = yes
		COLDWAR_CUB_foreign_reconcile_all = yes
		COLDWAR_CUB_sync_programmes = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_provisional_charter_applied
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_transition_charter_active }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_transition_charter_reviewed }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_transition_charter_reviewed
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CUB_core.1 }
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_CUB_repair_island_investment = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CUB_is_1970 = yes }
		1252 = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_cayo_blanco_del_sur has_state_category = state_inhospitable }
				set_state_category = state_00
			}
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_CUB_resolve_harvest = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_CUB_is_1970 = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_harvest_resolved }
		}
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CUB_zafra_campaign
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_harvest_resolved
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_harvest_rebalance }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_CUB_harvest_recovery_rebalanced days = 90 }
		}
		else = {
			add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_CUB_harvest_recovery days = 180 }
		}
		COLDWAR_CUB_sync_programmes = yes
	}
}
COLDWAR_CUB_refresh_institutions = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_security_civilian_enacted }
		remove_ideas = { COLDWAR_CUB_committees_defence COLDWAR_CUB_security_professional }
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_CUB_security_civilian
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_security_professional_enacted }
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CUB_committees_defence
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_CUB_security_professional
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_return_agreement_ratified
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_registered_returns_verified
		}
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CUB_exile_divide
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_CUB_exile_reconciled
	}
}
COLDWAR_CUB_observe_voluntary_return = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = USA
			check_variable = { gw_move_mode = 1 }
			check_variable = { gw_move_origin = CUB.id }
			check_variable = { gw_move_actual_k > 0 }
			CUB = { COLDWAR_CUB_is_1970 = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_return_agreement_ratified }
		}
		CUB = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_registered_returns_verified COLDWAR_CUB_refresh_institutions = yes }
	}
}
COLDWAR_CUB_refresh_dependency = {
	remove_ideas = {
		COLDWAR_CUB_sugar_oil
		COLDWAR_CUB_dependency_food
		COLDWAR_CUB_dependency_industry
		COLDWAR_CUB_dependency_diversified
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_food_first_applied has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_light_industry_applied }
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_CUB_dependency_diversified
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_food_first_applied }
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_CUB_dependency_food
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_light_industry_applied }
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_CUB_dependency_industry
	}
	else = { add_ideas = COLDWAR_CUB_sugar_oil }
	remove_ideas = { COLDWAR_CUB_supply_shortage_severe COLDWAR_CUB_supply_shortage_partial COLDWAR_CUB_supply_shortage_mitigated }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_verified_supply_shortage }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_food_first_applied has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_light_industry_applied }
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_CUB_supply_shortage_mitigated
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_food_first_applied has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CUB_light_industry_applied }
			}
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_CUB_supply_shortage_partial
		}
		else = { add_ideas = COLDWAR_CUB_supply_shortage_severe }
	}
}
